semantics: A := ALPHA*X*Y^T + A (rank-one update). There is no transpose flag: GER always forms x*y^T, and GER2/HER exist for the conjugate forms.
storage_convention: column_major for A; strided linear for X and Y.
preconditions: A is f64, rank 2, column_major, writable, strides [8, LDA*8].
X is an f64 rank-1 input of length M with positive stride.
Y is an f64 rank-1 input of length N with positive stride.
Declared capacity of A backs LDA*N doubles.
postconditions: On OK, A(i,j) = ALPHA*X(i)*Y(j) + A_old(i,j) for all i in [0,M), j in [0,N).

aliasing.note: DGER does not document behaviour when A aliases X or Y. In practice A(i,j) is written after X(i) and Y(j) are read for each (i,j) pair, which makes partial overlap order-dependent; MAGR does not rely on that.

numerical_contract.accumulation_order: A(i,j) := ALPHA*X(i)*Y(j) + A(i,j), one fused pass
numerical_contract.reproducibility_note: Single-pass update, so ordering is fixed by the routine. The compiler may contract into an FMA; pass -ffp-contract=off for bit-identity.
